name: 2022 World Championships Deck: Ice Rider Palkia

releases.name: 2022 World Championships Deck: Ice Rider Palkia

description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2022 World Championships. Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR's Subspace Swell does more damage for every Benched Pokémon on both sides, up to 290 against a Pokémon V with both Benches full and a Choice Belt, while Sobble fills the Bench and Inteleon finds the Trainer cards it needs. The 2022 World Championships were held at ExCeL London from 18 to 21 August 2022, the first in Europe and the first since 2019, after the COVID-19 pandemic put off the 2020 and 2021 events.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2022 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
